messages.text:
Build now succeeds through bundling and fails only at TypeScript strictness: one typed Link needs explicit search handling and the API tests need typed response shapes.

I’m fixing those compiler issues and ensuring the root route renders the outlet explicitly, then I’ll rerun build and browser smoke.
